decisions.title: Blame the working tree, not HEAD
decisions.rationale: Only a working-tree blame reports the all-zero sha that the uncommitted status depends on; blaming HEAD would make the uncommitted scenario unreachable.

decisions.title: Restart the lane after a scope rejection caused by a dirty loop-state
decisions.rationale: The first converge run rejected its own fix because loop-state.json was uncommitted before the fix and counted as a fix edit; loop-state was committed and the review rerun on the fixed plan.
